title: Okon's Other Souvenirs
description: Okon's Other Souvenirs — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Okon

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Clobber some tough guys anywhere within Upper MutantMania. Retrieve some souvenirs for Okon in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Okon

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Clobber some tough guys anywhere within Upper MutantMania. Retrieve some souvenirs for Okon in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

I bet thome other tough guyth have thome thweaty undies. I'm sure I can trade thee'th for thome good thtuff. If you can get thome more it would be great!

Turn-in:

Wowie, I can't believe you got more. Go thuper-fighter!

Objectives:

  • Sweaty Undies ×4

Level range: 82–92
